list.empty_all: No calls yet. Import the existing transcriptions to get started.

call.title_hint: Leave empty to show the date.

library.name: Name
library.folder_hint: Calls, audio and the database of this company live here. Backing up = copying this folder. A folder that already has a library.db is reused.

search.title: Results for “{q}”

import.title: Import
import.intro: Brings in calls from the old pipeline: call_*.txt (and _v2 as a new version), call_*.mic.wav / .sys.wav (copied as FLAC) and edits made in the HTML prototype. Original files are never deleted or moved.
import.target_hint: Calls already imported stay where they are. You can classify them later.
import.reclaim_hint: The app never deletes originals. Delete them yourself once you have checked the imported calls.
import.reclaim_none: No imported originals left on disk.
settings.title: Settings
settings.me_hint: Shown instead of “Me” in every call.
settings.data_dir_hint: Holds unclassified calls and settings. Change it with: tary settings data-dir <folder>
settings.companies_hint: Each company/project is a folder of its own with calls, audio and database.
settings.unregister_confirm: “{name}” leaves the app, but the folder {path} stays on disk with everything in it. You can add it back later.
settings.cli_hint: The same program works in the terminal (JSON output). Changes made there show up here right away and can be undone.
error.schema_too_new: Created by a newer version of the app
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Fixes for words the transcription gets wrong, kept just for you. Three layers: global rules apply everywhere, each company/project can override them, and each client can override the company's. Nothing changes in a call until you apply the glossary to it.
glossary.ctx_global_hint: These rules apply to every call, including unclassified ones, unless the company or a client has its own rule for the same pattern.
glossary.ctx_company_hint: These rules apply to every call in this company/project, with or without a client, and override global rules with the same pattern (those are greyed out). A client can override them.
glossary.ctx_client_hint: Precedence: client, then company, then global. A rule is greyed out when a more specific layer has the same pattern.
glossary.replace_hint: Swaps whole words after transcription, ignoring upper/lower case unless the rule is case-sensitive. A match in ALL CAPS stays in caps, a capitalized one stays capitalized.
glossary.term_hint: Terms do not change any text. During transcription they are sent to the model as vocabulary hints, which biases it toward these spellings without guaranteeing them. Keep the list short.
glossary.empty_replace: No replacements here yet. Add the words the transcription tends to get wrong and what they should be.
glossary.empty_term: No terms here yet. Add the names and jargon the model should expect.
glossary.overridden_by_client: Overridden by the client rule with the same pattern.
glossary.overridden_by_company: Overridden by the company rule with the same pattern.
glossary.case_hint: Only matches this exact upper/lower case
glossary.promote_hint: Move this rule to the global layer
glossary.promote_company_hint: Move this rule to the company/project layer
glossary.promote_company_confirm: “{pattern}” will apply to every call in this company/project, and the client's copy is removed.
glossary.promote_confirm: “{pattern}” will apply to every call, and the copy in this client is removed.
glossary.promote_confirm_company: “{pattern}” will apply to every call, and this company's copy is removed.
glossary.remove_confirm: Remove “{what}” from the glossary? Text already changed by it stays as it is.
glossary.f_pattern_hint: Whole words; spaces match any amount of spaces; punctuation is literal. Up to 200 characters.
glossary.f_case_hint: Off by default: “zenit”, “Zenit” and “ZENIT” are the same.
glossary.prompt_usage: Terms in the model prompt: {fit} of {total}
glossary.prompt_over: The terms that do not fit are cut off. Remove the least useful ones.
glossary.imp_format: UTF-8 text, one entry per line. “wrong -> right” (also → and =>) is a replacement, anything else is a term. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
glossary.open_hint: See and edit this call's client rules, or apply the glossary to the call
glossary.modal_intro: Nothing changes in the call until you apply the glossary to it.
glossary.client_empty: No rules for this client yet. Add the corrections and terms its calls usually need.
glossary.company_hint: Read-only here. They apply to every call in this company/project, unless the client has a rule for the same pattern.
glossary.manage_company: Manage company rules in the Glossary page
glossary.global_hint: Read-only here. They apply to every call, unless the company or the client has a rule for the same pattern.
glossary.manage_global: Manage global rules in the Glossary page
glossary.no_client_title: This call has no client yet
glossary.no_client_body: Each client has its own glossary. Classify this call to see and edit it; the rules below still apply.
glossary.pending_note: No transcript yet, so there is nothing to apply. The terms listed here help when the call is transcribed.
glossary.finish_first: Save or cancel the rule you are editing first.
glossary.apply_none: Nothing to change: no rule matches this call.
glossary.apply_undo_hint: Everything is saved as one step: Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch.
glossary.applied_one: Glossary applied (1 passage) · Ctrl+Z to undo
glossary.applied_other: Glossary applied ({n} passages) · Ctrl+Z to undo
glossary.err.conflict: A rule of this type with this pattern already exists in this layer.
glossary.err.invalid: Invalid entry: the pattern and the replacement cannot be empty or identical (limits: 200 and 500 characters).
glossary.err.not_found: Not found: the rule or client may have been removed.
glossary.err.promote_conflict: A global rule with this pattern already has a different replacement. Edit or remove one of them first.
glossary.err.promote_company_conflict: A company rule with this pattern already has a different replacement. Edit or remove one of them first.
glossary.err.import_invalid: The file must be UTF-8 text up to 2 MB.
glossary.err.same: The replacement must differ from the pattern.
record.speakers: How many people on the call? (at most)
record.speakers_hint: Only people who speak become speakers; the number is just a limit (1 to 20). Leave empty to count automatically.
record.both_off: Turn on at least the microphone or the system audio.
record.no_backend: Audio server not found (PulseAudio, or PipeWire with Pulse compatibility). Recording is not possible without it.
record.mic_silent: No microphone audio for {s} s. Is it muted, or is this the wrong device?
record.sys_silent: No system audio for {s} s. Is the call playing on another output (for example, the headset)?
record.switched: Switching system audio to “{device}”, the output where sound is playing. This is automatic and expected, not an app failure.
record.cuts_one: 1 reconnection during recording: a short stretch may be silent.
record.cuts_other: {n} reconnections during recording: short stretches may be silent.
record.err_speakers: Maximum people: use a whole number from 1 to 20 (or leave it empty to count automatically).
record.done: Recording saved as a new call, waiting for transcription.
record.toast_empty: Nothing was recorded: the recording was empty and was discarded.
record.warn_monitor: System audio captures everything the computer plays (calls, videos, notifications), not just the meeting.
record.warn_screen: When you share the whole screen, the mini bar and this window are visible to others. On Linux they cannot be hidden from capture: share a specific window or tab instead.
record.warn_consent: Capturing system audio can record other people's voices. Tell the participants and get consent where the law or company policy requires it.
recovery.title: Recordings to recover
recovery.intro: The app closed (or the system crashed) during these recordings. The audio captured up to that point is saved: recover it to create the call, or discard it.
transcription.pending_body: This call's audio is saved and will be transcribed automatically, one call at a time.
transcription.running_body: Transcription is running in the background. The text will appear here when it finishes.
settings.record.title: Recording
settings.record.devices_hint: Used by the shortcut, the tray and the command line; on the Record screen you can change them each time.
settings.record.bar_on_start: Show the mini bar when recording starts
settings.record.shortcut_hint: Click the field and press the combination (use Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Super).
settings.record.shortcut_unsupported: The global shortcut only works on X11 sessions; this session is {session}. Use your compositor's shortcut to run “tary record toggle”.
settings.record.wayland_other: Wayland session: the app's global shortcut does not work. Bind a key in your compositor to the command
settings.record.hypr_title: Wayland / Hyprland: bar window and shortcut
settings.record.hypr_intro: On Hyprland the app cannot keep itself on top or position itself. These rules make the mini bar float, stay pinned on every workspace, not steal focus and sit in the top-right corner, and bind Ctrl+Alt+R to recording.
settings.record.hypr_version: The syntax depends on your Hyprland version (it changed in recent releases). Check yours with “hyprctl version” and use the matching block; after pasting, reload the configuration.
settings.record.hypr_note_title: The rule matches the window's initial title (“tary-bar”), which the app sets on creation.
settings.record.hypr_note_bind: The “bind” runs the command line tool, which starts the app if it is not running.
error.already_recording: A recording is already in progress
error.device_open_failed: Could not open the audio device
transcription.setup_body: Transcription runs on this computer. A one-time download of about 1.7 GB is needed (speech models and the Python environment).
transcription.queued_body: This call is queued and will be transcribed next.
transcription.setup_needed: Transcription still needs to be set up (Settings).
queue.title: Transcription queue
queue.paused_recording: Paused while you record; it resumes by itself afterwards.
queue.cancel_confirm: Cancel this transcription? Partial progress is discarded.
call.rediarize_speakers: How many people on the call? (at most; only people who speak become speakers; empty = the call's value)
call.no_raw: This version was imported: voices cannot be separated again.
call.bleed_hint: Parts of your microphone discarded because they repeated the system audio. If one was really you, use “Without the echo filter”.
settings.transcription.title: Transcription
settings.transcription.hotwords: Use glossary terms to help the transcription
settings.transcription.low_priority: Low priority (does not slow the rest of the computer)
settings.transcription.bleed_filter: Echo filter (microphone repeating the system audio)
error.worker_protocol: Invalid reply from the transcription process
error.no_raw_data: This version has no data to redo
queue.already_open: This call already has a transcription in the queue.
transcription.setup_cancelled: Setup cancelled. What was already downloaded is kept and you can resume.
transcription.pending_body_manual: This call's audio is saved. Automatic transcription is off: start it whenever you like.
call.rediarize_hint: Reuses the transcription and only redoes who said each passage. Creates a new version.
call.resegment_hint: Rebuilds the blocks from data already computed, without processing the audio. Creates a new version.
call.resegment_nobleed_hint: Like rebuilding, but without discarding microphone passages as echo.
call.retranscribe_hint: Transcribes the whole audio again. Takes a while; creates a new version.
transcription.queued_hint: In the queue; it will be transcribed next.
transcription.why.paused_user: The queue is paused. This call will be transcribed when you resume it.
transcription.why.paused_recording: The queue is paused while you record. It resumes by itself afterwards.
transcription.why.runtime_installing: The transcription engine is being installed or updated. This call starts when it finishes.
transcription.why.runtime_missing: The transcription engine is not installed, so this call cannot start.
transcription.why.runtime_outdated: The transcription engine needs an update, so this call cannot start.
transcription.why.models_missing: The transcription models have not been downloaded yet, so this call cannot start.
transcription.why.behind_one: Waiting its turn: 1 transcription ahead of this one.
transcription.why.behind_other: Waiting its turn: {n} transcriptions ahead of this one.
transcription.engine.outdated: The transcription engine needs an update. The queue is stopped until then.
transcription.engine.outdated_note: The models you already downloaded are kept and are not downloaded again.
transcription.engine.missing: The transcription engine is not installed. The queue is stopped until it is.
call.select_hint: Select passages to delete several at once
delete.confirm_body: Deleting is reversible: the content disappears from the call and from search, but the original text and the audio are kept. You can undo it right away or from the history. If the call has audio, that passage's audio stops playing (it becomes a cut) and is ignored when you redo the transcription.
player.unreadable: Could not open this call's audio: {error}
player.missing: This call's audio files were not found.
audio.warn_intro: The transcript and its text stay. Without the audio you can no longer:
audio.warn_redo: redo the transcription (separate the voices again or transcribe everything again)
audio.gone_note: This call's audio was deleted on {date}. You can no longer listen to it, cut it or redo the transcription; the text is still here.
audio.redo_off: Unavailable: this call's audio was deleted.
audio.err_busy: This call is being recorded or has a transcription queued or running. Try again when it finishes.
audio.storage_hint: Delete the audio of already transcribed calls to free up space. The transcript stays.
audio.storage_none: No calls with audio on disk.
error.not_transcribed: The call has not been transcribed yet
cut.open_hint: Mark what should go in the audio (tangents, side conversations)
cut.title: Cut audio
cut.hint: Drag over the waveform to mark what goes. Whatever is cut is not played and is ignored when you redo the transcription; the audio files do not change.
cut.silence_note: There is no need to cut silences: transcription already ignores them and they barely change the generation time.
cut.empty: No cuts yet. Drag over the player's waveform.
cut.confirm_none: No passage of the transcript will be deleted.
cut.confirm_body_one: 1 passage will be deleted from the transcript: half or more of it is inside the cuts. You can undo it right away or from the history.
cut.confirm_body_other: {n} passages will be deleted from the transcript: half or more of each one is inside the cuts. You can undo it right away or from the history.
cut.nothing_new: That part of the audio was already cut.
cut.drag_label: Cut: drag to mark the audio range
purge.company_empty: “{name}” has no calls. The company leaves the app and its database is removed.
purge.client_empty: “{name}” has no calls. The client and its glossary will be deleted.
purge.company_scope: Also deleted: {clients} client(s) and {entries} glossary rule(s) (company and clients).
purge.client_scope: Also deleted: {entries} glossary rule(s) of this client.
purge.company_calls: “{name}” has {calls} ({size} of audio). What should happen to them?
purge.client_calls: “{name}” has {calls} ({size} of audio). What should happen to them?
purge.company_keep_hint: Moving takes the calls, with audio and transcript, to Unclassified. The company and its clients are deleted.
purge.client_keep_hint: Moving leaves the calls in the company, without a client. The client is deleted.
purge.erase_warn: Deleting removes the calls, transcripts, edits and audio from disk. This can't be undone.
purge.done_moved_client_one: “{name}” deleted. 1 call is now without a client.
purge.done_moved_client_other: “{name}” deleted. {count} calls are now without a client.
purge.done_erased_company_one: “{name}” deleted, with 1 call and its audio.
purge.done_erased_company_other: “{name}” deleted, with {count} calls and their audio.
purge.done_erased_client_one: “{name}” deleted, with 1 call and its audio.
purge.done_erased_client_other: “{name}” deleted, with {count} calls and their audio.
purge.leftover: Left in the folder because they aren't the app's: {items}.
settings.delete_hint: “Remove from list” only hides the company in the app: the folder and calls stay on disk. “Delete” removes it for real.
